newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil seen unchanged to 50 cents higher.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil seen unchanged to 50 cents higher.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures were expected to open slightly higher on firm buying in the U.S. overnight, with Brent seen 10 to 15 cents higher at the start.
July gas oil was expected to open between unchanged and 50 cents higher from its previous closing price of $161.75 a tonne. August Brent was seen opening 10 to 15 cents higher from its $17.86 close.
Dealers attributed the anticipated gains purely to strength in the U.S. and Singapore markets overnight.
August Brent traded on SIMEX at $18 a barrel, up 14 cents.
ACCESS out of hours trading pushed July heating oil 41 cents higher to $52.35 a gallon while crude oil pushed up 23 cents to $19.24 a barrel.
"We should open a little higher, the gains on ACCESS should filter through," one dealer said.
Singapore's gas oil market, which has been depressed by a prompt overhang of material, has been consolidating around new support levels after refineries cut crude runs.
Shell Singapore said on Tuesday it had initiated a planned crude run cut of 2,000 tonnes per day for the rest of June. -- Paul Carrel, London newsroom +44 171 542 8185
